inputs.root_cause: User directive (2026-08-11): 'OASIS did not publish an example does not mean a writer cannot be tested. A writer can be tested against normative schemas, semantic rules, deterministic synthetic fixtures, round trips, and available public examples.' UBL-WRITE-001's own missing_behavior named 36 of 91 supported root types with no official OASIS example in any UBL release, treated as a hard data-acquisition blocker.
inputs.obligation_targeted: SAL-UBL-OBL-F9D5251F2302AE3A (UBL-WRITE-001), narrowed (not closed): the 36-type official-example gap is unchanged and still genuinely open, but all 36 types now have independent schema-valid round-trip proof via synthetic fixtures, which the obligation's own rule_text (round-trip proof against schema-valid content) does not require to be OASIS-authored.
inputs.acceptance_evidence: tools/ubl/generate_synthetic_document_samples.py walks each of the 36 types' own vendored official OASIS maindoc XSD (src/python/ubl/src/format_factory/ubl/validation/schemas/maindoc/) using the xmlschema library's real content-model introspection, builds the smallest tree satisfying every minOccurs>=1 particle recursively (choice groups take their first branch only), fills leaf text via primitive-type-appropriate deterministic placeholders (honoring an enumeration facet when the schema restricts one; refuses to guess for an unhandled pattern restriction rather than emit unverified content), and serializes each via this package's own public dumps(). All 36/36 generated and validated against the real official schema on first execution -- zero manual per-type fixes needed.
inputs.regression_tier: full ubl package suite, mypy, ruff

execution_steps: 1. Confirmed all 36 missing-example root types have a typed ROOT_CLASSES subclass already (document_types.py's own claim that every one of 91 UBL 2.3 root types is fully typed) -- zero not found.

2. Inspected xmlschema's own XsdElement/XsdComplexType/XsdGroup object model directly against a simple type (DocumentStatusRequest: 2 required leaf elements, ID and IssueDate) and a complex type with required nested aggregates (Catalogue: ID, IssueDate, ProviderParty, ReceiverParty, CatalogueLine) to confirm has_simple_content()/content/model/min_occurs give everything needed to walk a content model generically, without a hand-maintained per-type field list.

3. Checked whether required leaf types carry enumeration/pattern facets (ID/IssueDate: neither) and whether any required attributes exist on the sampled types (none) -- confirmed most codes/facets in UBL are on optional (minOccurs=0) elements, which a minimal-instance generator naturally never touches.

4. Wrote the generic recursive builder: _build_element_node (leaf simple-content -> placeholder text + any required attributes; complex content -> recurse into its own group) and _walk_group (sequence/all -> every minOccurs>=1 particle; choice -> first branch only), with a depth guard (40) against schema cycles.

5. Ran the generator against all 36 types. Result: 36/36 generated and schema-valid on the first execution (schema_validate() against each type's own real official XSD) -- confirmed via a background run since 36 sequential xmlschema.XMLSchema() constructions (each pulling in the full shared common-component schema graph) took several minutes.

6. Built a manifest (samples/by-format/ubl/synthetic/_synthetic-corpus-manifest.yaml) programmatically from the generated files' own sha256/size, explicitly labeled provenance_status: SYNTHETIC_SCHEMA_DERIVED for every entry -- never presented as an OASIS example, mirroring but clearly distinguished from the official corpus's own manifest style.

7. Wrote tests/python/ubl/test_obligation_synthetic_sample_roundtrip.py: a manifest-driven parametrized suite (5 test methods x 36 types + 1 manifest-integrity test = 181 tests) proving manifest-hash integrity, real official-schema validity, successful load, round-trip stability (load -> dumps -> reload, still schema-valid), and that every fixture declares a UBL 2.3-compatible version (never given a free pass past the same stable-profile gate real documents must clear).

8. Ran the new test file alone (181/181 passed, ~145s -- schema_validate() reloads the target XSD per call, the same cost profile the existing 55-official-sample test file already has), mypy (clean), ruff (clean), then the full ubl suite (1958 passed, 0 failed, up from 1777).

evidence.product_promotion_effect: 1 obligation narrowed (partial -> partial, corrected missing_behavior: all 91 supported root types now have schema-valid round-trip evidence, official or synthetic; only the official-example provenance gap for 36 types and the single structurally-incompatible CommonTransportationReport sample remain genuinely open), not closed
evidence.new_public_api: none -- tools/ubl/generate_synthetic_document_samples.py consumes only this package's own existing public API (dumps, loads, ROOT_CLASSES, schema_validate, XmlNode); no src/python/ubl/ file was modified
